item.title: 🔴 Funnel Builder WordPress plugin bug exploited to steal credit cards
item.description:
Why this matters: RCE vulnerability — patch immediately, check for exposed attack surface.
A critical vulnerability in the Funnel Builder plugin for WordPress is being actively exploited to inject malicious JavaScript snippets into WooCommerce checkout pages. [...]
